title: Cambridge IELTS 20 Academic Speaking Test 4
instruction: This is a full IELTS Speaking Mock Test. Record your answer for each question and submit when ready.

tasks.title: Part 1 - Question 1
tasks.question: What do you think your best personal qualities are? [Why?]

tasks.title: Part 1 - Question 2
tasks.question: Do you have the same personal qualities as your parents? [Why/Why not?]

tasks.title: Part 1 - Question 3
tasks.question: What personal qualities are important to you in a friend? [Why?]

tasks.title: Part 1 - Question 4
tasks.question: Do you think you have the personal qualities to be a good/successful leader? [Why/Why not?]

tasks.title: Part 2 - Cue Card (Question 5)
tasks.question:
Describe a time when you had a long discussion about a news story.

You should say:
- what the news story was about
- who you discussed this news story with
- what people's opinions were and explain why you had such a long discussion about this news story.

tasks.title: Part 3 - Question 6
tasks.question: How do most people find out about the news in your country?

tasks.title: Part 3 - Question 7
tasks.question: Are people more interested in local news than national news?

tasks.title: Part 3 - Question 8
tasks.question: How important is it to know about international news?

tasks.title: Part 3 - Question 9
tasks.question: Why are discussion programmes involving members of the public popular on [TV and radio]?

tasks.title: Part 3 - Question 10
tasks.question: What kinds of people want to take part in discussion programmes?

tasks.title: Part 3 - Question 11
tasks.question: Do discussion programmes influence people in a good or bad way?

tips: Try to expand your answers, especially in Part 3.
Use your 1 minute preparation time in Part 2 wisely to make notes.
Do not worry if the examiner interrupts you - this is normal.
